svg.text: Figure 3. Structurability map — major categories × machine-processing properties (sorted by fragmentation index)
Colour is the relative position within each column (min–max). Higher template compliance, and lower uniqueness, fragmentation and type mismatch, favour rule-based processing.
Darker cell = relatively more amenable to rule-based processing within the column. Fragmentation index is the rule-key stage (before embedding).
